walkthrough.use_case: Create an imagined street and try one weather change while exploring.
walkthrough.steps:
Open Project Genie and choose Genie 4 if available.
Describe a sunny street with a blue door. Enter the world.
While exploring, type “Make it snow.” Check whether the blue door stays put.

youtube_description:
Google began rolling out Genie 4 in Project Genie on November 18. Imagine walking down a sunny street and asking it to snow while you keep exploring. That is the kind of mid-session change Google now documents in its browser-based interactive worlds.

If you have access, choose Genie 4 in Project Genie, describe an invented street with a blue door, and try one weather change. On your way back, see whether the door and surroundings stay consistent. The example is illustrative. We reviewed Google's rollout and model card without running a live session.

Google AI Ultra account, age and regional eligibility apply. Google AI Pro members can join the waitlist. The model is experimental and details may drift as you explore.
